card.name: Gaps before numbers in PPI dosing
card.fires_on: Spaces, small linking words and commas right before a dose number or a combination-drug partner. Seen in acid-reducing drug labels, H. pylori regimens and dosing tables.

modes.label: Space before dose
modes.description: The blank space between 'of' or a drug name and a number such as 40 mg or 14 kg.
modes.example: Active Benign Gastric Ulcer<< >>40 mg once daily for 4

modes.label: Link in combination regimens
modes.description: A 'with', 'and' or comma joining drugs in a combination therapy list.
modes.example: Administer three bismuth subcitrate potassium<<,>> metronidazole and tetracy
